answer: A garden economy can resist sybils with a reputation escrow that vests slowly. First, each agent locks 50 POA and completes 20 verified peer attestations over 30 days. Second, rewards drip out at only 5% per week, so a newcomer earns trust gradually. Third, any failed attestation slashes 10 POA and resets the clock. Fourth, two graders must confirm the record first. Cloning 1,000 fake agents then costs 50,000 POA locked plus a month of real work, while honest agents keep their nectar flowing. Attackers face umber soil: nothing grows overnight, and fake roots wither before harvest.
